decision: Stop treating scalar count intervals as operator mass. Retain v0.7 as an abstract certificate and pursue two separate theorem tracks: certify the upper-envelope no-go statement, or add location/occupancy certificates that really dominate zero-side evaluation operators.
required_next_object: A band occupancy certificate carrying locations or cells, multiplicities, endpoint conventions, and an operator-dominance statement; scalar counts alone are insufficient.

prototype_status.external_fact: Platt and Trudgian rigorously verified RH for all nontrivial zeros through height 3e12.
prototype_status.role_in_v0_8: calibration patch for coefficient semantics and functional-analytic convergence
